messages:
Meera Patel: Kickoff: we need a multi-cloud Terraform deliverable for the marketplace listing. Scope: a tiny, opinionated reference module for AWS & GCP (single entrypoint with provider abstraction), plus an optional autoscaler module and a marketplace packaging README. Ship target: next Fri.
Carlos Ruiz: Sounds good. Proposal: `modules/core` (VPC, subnets, compute + LB), `modules/autoscale` (optional ASG / instance group), and `examples/marketplace` with minimal app and docs. Keep variables explicit and documented.
Tom Chen: For AWS I'll do `modules/core/aws` and the AMI packaging checklist. We'll support `ami_id` and `ami_lookup` modes. Also will add a small `packer` example rather than full pipeline.
Jordan Lee: I'll mirror for GCP: `modules/core/gcp` with instance template + managed instance group. I'll include a `startup-script.sh` and a sample `cloudbuild.yaml`.
Alice Ng: Legal/security reminder: include a short "Reviewer checklist" file with CIS highlights, recommended IAM roles, and encryption notes. Keep it 1 page.
Carlos Ruiz: Quick naming convention suggestion: `redwood_marketplace_<cloud>_<component>` for resource tags/labels so reviewers can find them. Also include a `tags`/`labels` variable.
Meera Patel: Good. Testing: each example should have a tiny `deploy.sh` that runs `terraform init && plan -out=tfplan && apply tfplan` and then hits the sample nginx endpoint. Add `make test-aws` / `make test-gcp` to run smoke checks.
Tom Chen: Small terraform snippet idea for provider abstraction (to include in docs):
```terraform
locals { cloud = var.cloud }
provider "aws" { region = var.region }
provider "google" { region = var.region }
module "core" { source = "./modules/core/${local.cloud}" }
```
Jordan Lee: Note: for GCP marketplace we must include an image family and a `startup-script`. I'll draft the `cloudbuild` and `gcp/README.md` with submission hints.
ci-bot: CI tip: add a `tfsec` and `tflint` stage to the repo pipeline. Fail on critical security findings.
Carlos Ruiz: Automation: I'll add a small script `scripts/generate-marketplace-manifest.sh` that fills in LICENSE, pricing placeholders, and points to the `examples/marketplace` artifact.
Alice Ng: Action owners: Tom = AWS module + AMI checklist, Jordan = GCP module + cloudbuild + image notes, Carlos = repo skeleton + manifest generator + CI bits, Meera = consolidate reviewer checklist + coordinate legal sign-off. Deadline: next Fri COB.
Meera Patel: Thanks. Please post PR links here. If we hit packaging policy issues, ping me and I'll escalate to partners-legal. :rocket:
